rationale: learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=3, lpd_hidden=48, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_share_weights=False, lr=0.0005, lr_schedule=cosine, epochs=10, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-2 search-20260619-01: SINGLE coupled knob = trade unroll depth for epochs. iter-1 (lpd_iters=5, epochs=6) scored SSIM 0.84271 / hr 0.000 in 1149.5s = 19.2min, i.e. AT the 20-min wall with hr stuck at the LD-FBP floor (budget-limited unrolled net, under-trained). No headroom to raise epochs alone. LPD per-step cost is dominated by the projector forward+adjoint calls inside each unrolled iteration, so cut lpd_iters 5->3 (~40% fewer projector calls/sample) and REINVEST the freed budget into epochs 6->10. Everything else held EXACTLY at iter-1 (hidden=48, n_primal=5, n_dual=5, lr=5e-4 cosine, train_n=200, batch=1, val_chunk=1, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). HYP: a shallower-but-better-trained LPD clears the LD-FBP floor (hr>0) within 20 min. FALSIFIER: hr stays 0.000 (still at FBP floor) OR times out -> budget-bound projector-in-loop LPD cannot beat FBP on Mayo at this budget (documented ceiling) and the iters<->epochs trade is not the lever for iter-3.
